sources.purpose: Season 9.5 The Hood role, base health, abilities, and Team-Up effects.

notes: The Season 9 baseline included The Hood as an inactive Vanguard; this Season 9.5 snapshot activates him and retains his two directional links.
Inactive heroes are valid Team-Up partners but are excluded from generated six-hero teams.
Deadpool uses Duelist as his primary role and Strategist as an eligible flex role for 2-2-2 assignment.
This project does not hardcode generated team results; counts are derived from heroes.json and teamups.json.

Team-Up effect summaries are stored separately in teamup_effects.json. Official hero pages are the primary source; entries without official hero-page details are kept as null and marked needs_verification instead of guessed.
The Hood is active as a Vanguard in Season 9.5 with Scarlet Witch and Moon Knight as his two directional Team-Up partners.
